question: Which region ID has high income inequality? Explain reasons behind it
query: SELECT gcam_region_id, AVG(gini_reported) AS avg_gini_reported, AVG(income_net) AS avg_income_net FROM country_income WHERE year = ( SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_income ) GROUP BY gcam_region_id ORDER BY avg_gini_reported DESC LIMIT 5;
answer: Region ID 24 shows the highest income inequality, indicated by an average Gini coefficient of 0.6496 and an average net income of 0.1004. This suggests a significant gap between the rich and poor within this region. Regions 4 and 1 also have high Gini coefficients (0.52 and 0.51 respectively), and Region 1 also has the lowest average net income among the four regions listed.
